limitations: Public web/news uses GDELT DOC 2.0 (public query API) and optional official NewsAPI. Google News HTML/RSS is not fetched because robots.txt disallows /rss.
Article bodies are not scraped. Title/description plus source URL and publication date are retained.
Country is set only when the source supplies geography. English language is not treated as South Africa.
NewsAPI UNAVAILABLE until NEWS_API_KEY is configured.
Social & Consumer Intelligence V1 is an external context layer. It does not modify frozen POS or macro agents.
Social observations are never invented. Unavailable sources stay unavailable.
Missing fields stay null. Missing is never converted to zero.
Author identifiers are hashed. Unnecessary personal information is not stored.
Sentiment is not treated as sales causality.
Social intelligence does not create a commercial action or recalculate addressable value or volume.
Future social observations are not used to explain historical POS periods.
HIGH confidence is never assigned from a single post.
Dashboard is not built in this sprint.
A need is listed only when supported by actual observations at the configured frequency threshold.
No recurring needs met the evidence threshold.
